searchText: i have further simplification proposal https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/524 Hi <@656728086410297356> just checking to see if this `beacon-api` spec covering `getBlobSidecars` is blocked by anything or if it can be merged It can be merged 🫡 Could I get some more eyes on this change? I would like to merge it soon. `engine_getBlobsV2` metrics proposal: `beacon_engine_getBlobsV2_requests_total` - Total number of engine_getBlobsV2 requests to an execution layer (Counter) `beacon_engine_getBlobsV2_responses_total` - Total number of engine_getBlobsV2 successful responses from an execution layer (Couter) Do we need to count null responses as well? They are considered to be a successful result. https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/blob/main/src/engine/osaka.md#response-1 what about just returning blobs, based on https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1355219344011038912 there was a slight preference for that I don't have a preference, and iirc in last week's call, we kinda settled on merging it first and update if we get more push for this it would be good if people could signal on the PR in that case, or post a summary there of what was discussed I have been asking for that for quite some time 😅, I'll address the comments and post a summary there which one? https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/524 I feel it like they are two different places to observe and potentially different metrics. Engine API is more for inner testing and troubleshooting, for devnets. Beacon API is more for users, L2s, etc. We may ask <@412614104222531604> , what would you like to see/test? <@656728086410297356> added a comment on your PR, and also asked internally in the Arbitrum team to have their opinion about returning blobs instead of blob sidecars.

excerpts.author: sibkatya
excerpts.content:
`engine_getBlobsV2` metrics proposal:

`beacon_engine_getBlobsV2_requests_total` - Total number of engine_getBlobsV2 requests to an execution layer (Counter)
`beacon_engine_getBlobsV2_responses_total` - Total number of engine_getBlobsV2 successful responses from an execution layer (Couter)

Do we need to count null responses as well? They are considered to be a successful result.
https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/blob/main/src/engine/osaka.md#response-1
